name: People's Garment Public Company Limited
summary: People's Garment Public Company Limited manufactures and sells ready-to-wear garments in Thailand. The company offers menswear, ladies wear, children's wear, swimwear, sportswear, cycling wear, and men's underwear under the Arrow, Elle, Felix Buhler, Lecoq Sportif, Streamline, BSC, Primo Linea, Proud, 360, Swoop, and Oberon brands. It also produces and sells knitted fabrics, and ready-to-wear garments made from woven and knitted fabrics, as well as uniforms. The company also exports its products to Asia, the United States, and the Europeans Union. People's Garment Public Company Limited was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
